about: Every trading idea tested on this bot and the verdict. Out-of-sample walk-forward (train 180d / test 60d) on Upbit 4h data 2021-10..2026-10, fees 0.05% + slippage 0.05% per side, unless noted. Read this before proposing or testing an idea; re-test only if the data or the bot changed materially.
in_production: donchian + ema_cross, equal sub-accounts (steadier: positive quarters 42% -> 63%)

entry confirmation: 3 of 4 (coin > EMA200, BTC > EMA200, day volume >= 30d avg, <= 3 ATR above EMA50) (dev Sharpe 1.44 -> 1.80, MDD -16% -> -10%, lockbox +0.5% -> +6.5%; also better on a 2h-shifted clock)
inverse-volatility weights across coins (MDD -6 to -8 pts)
fixed ATR stop + giveback guard: after +30% sell 15% below the high (Sharpe 1.15 -> 1.35; mostly 2024-12-03)
daily loss limit -5% and kill switch -35% per sleeve
weekly walk-forward re-selection of parameters; a sleeve stops new entries when it stopped working
real slippage learned from live fills feeds the weekly re-selection
self-review: add/drop one strategy only if better on old data AND not worse on the last 180 days; user approves

rejected.idea: break-even stop, 12% hard stop cap, wider stop grid
rejected.result: no gain or fails one half

rejected.idea: volatility cap 2.5%/day; all 4 strategies equal split
copying Wonyotti's BitMEX positions / imitation ML
meta-labeling: logistic filter on past trades (8 features)

rejected.result: Sharpe 1.80 but 1st half worse; gain came from one quarter via parameter path, not the gate. Watch, do not use

rejected.idea: skip entries whose round-trip cost > 10% of the stop distance
choose parameters by CAGR instead of Sharpe
4h bars shifted 2h off the common clock (anti-crowding)
rejected.result: +167% -> +92%; the bot depends on Upbit's 00 UTC bar alignment

rejected.idea: confirmation 4 of 4, or 3 of 3 with any rule dropped
wider universe: top 10/20 coins by 30-day KRW turnover instead of 5 fixed coins
rejected.result: dev +9.8% / +1.9% vs +197% for the 5 coins (with confirmation), 2nd half negative; despite survivorship bias in its favour

rejected.idea: surge coins: add coins whose turnover jumped >= 5x (top 20 that day) for 7 days, same rules
rejected.result: dev -33% vs +197%, MDD -36%; 627 surge-coin trades, 19% won, mean -4.5%; 3-day window and 3x trigger also fail

pending: LightGBM filter on ~24 features, Kronos-small forecast filter: results/data_study.md

ai sleeve (Claude/GPT propose + cross-review, shared rulebook): untested. LLM decisions cannot be backtested honestly (the models saw the prices in training); judge only from forward paper results, 28 days minimum before live
costs: fees + slippage take ~14% of gross profit (+196.7% before costs -> +168.4% after, 2022-04..2026-03); about half each
goal: maximum net profit after fees and slippage, with the worst drawdown kept above -30% (kill switch at -35%); not a daily target
